machines.title: Post queue
machines.blurb: Posted requires approval. The server also allows posted straight from approved, skipping the cue.

invariants.name: ScheduledBeforePosted
invariants.text: Posted happens only after the item was cued.

story.label: Mark posted is accepted before the cue.
